title: Migraine Friendly Workspace - A Swiss Brain Health Initiative
content: Migraine affects around one billion individuals worldwide, many in their working life, leading to significant personal and societal burden. As the modern working environments continue to change, as do expectations of new generations of employees. The importance of creating migraine friendly workspaces becomes pressing. The Swiss Headache Society’s migraine friendly workspace (MFWS) proposal aims at reducing direct and indirect costs associated with migraine in the workspace and provides practical recommendations and interventions for designing environments that promote employee well-being and productivity.
